notes: 2018_00_link is the Rev 5.2011 faculty FMLA policy, superseded by the 01/2018 version (2018_03), which is coded. The two texts give the same leave terms (12 weeks paid parental leave, six months paid medical leave, 26-week combined limit); 2011 says 'same-sex domestic partner' where 2018 says 'same-sex spouse'.

2018_03 (01/2018) is flagged version_uncertain on every component citing it, per the recorded acceptance. 2018_04 (01/2018) carries no such decision and is read as in force; its only capture is also 2019-11-21.

The Faculty Handbook saved (April 2017 revisions) is a proxy: its metadata records that the version in force on the reference date was approved August 14, 2017 and is not saved. Components citing it are flagged version_uncertain. The leave sections relied on (III.B.1.b.iii, III.C.4-5, V.A.3.e) agree with the 01/2018 FMLA policy where they overlap (postponement rule).

2018_02 (HR Leaves of Absence page) is largely navigation, with a short summary of faculty and staff medical leave processes; it links policies not saved (FMLA for Staff, Military Leave Policy, Domestic Violence Policy, Small Necessities Leave Act, Massachusetts Parental Leave Act text).

Not components: sabbatical leave (Handbook III.C.4.a: research and professional improvement) and professional leave without pay (III.C.5.a.iii: scholarly activity) cannot be used for a birth; the Provost's release of faculty with major administrative responsibilities from part of teaching (III.C.2.g.ii.(3)) is not a parental provision; FMLA 'transfer faculty to alternative teaching schedules or assignments' for foreseeable intermittent leave is an employer option, not relief. Staff personal, military or professional leaves (HR page) are mentioned without terms and not coded.
Unpaid FMLA leave: 'paid on a prorated basis based on an academic year of thirty-nine (39) weeks' (salary reduced pro rata for unpaid weeks); the 39 weeks is a pay basis, not a term length (R8).
Calendar: semesters (two semesters of service, three consecutive semesters, fall and spring terms); no length stated, so calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order.

Birth parent chain: medical leave for own disability (c2, up to 6 months, salary c3 within it) and paid Parental Leave (c1, 12 weeks) linked also_available (order not stated), the two together capped at 26 weeks (leave_limits); FMLA (c4) concurrent_with c2 and c1 from the start; MA Parental Leave (c5, 8 weeks) concurrent_with FMLA.

Non-birth parent chain: paid Parental Leave (c1, 12 weeks, primary caregiver) with FMLA (c4) concurrent_with it; MA Parental Leave (c5, 8 weeks) concurrent_with FMLA. c2/c3 (own condition) do not count for this role.

Primary-care condition on paid Parental Leave (c1) excludes a parent whose child is in the full-time care of a spouse; treated as gender-neutral (R6). FMLA newborn care is unpaid for a member who does not qualify for paid Parental Leave.

Documents cited but not saved: Faculty Handbook approved August 14, 2017 (per metadata); FMLA Faculty Policy 08.2016 (per metadata); Family Medical Leave Policy for Staff / FMLA Staff Policy; Military Leave Policy; Domestic Violence Policy; Small Necessities Leave Act (SNLA); Massachusetts Parental Leave Act statute text; Long-Term Disability Insurance plan; Health and Dental Benefits for Same-Sex Domestic Partners policy (2018_00 footnote); Contract Faculty Guidelines; additional postponement guidelines approved by the Committee on Faculty Rights and Responsibilities; Faculty and Staff leave application forms.
